name: What are the main benefits of installing a curbless shower?

mainEntity.name: What are the main benefits of installing a curbless shower?

acceptedAnswer.text: Installing a curbless shower offers several key benefits. Enhanced accessibility is a primary advantage, making it easier for people of all ages and mobility levels to enter and exit. This design significantly reduces the risk of falls. Aesthetically, curbless showers contribute to a more open, spacious, and contemporary bathroom feel, which can increase a home's appeal and value. Cleaning is also simplified without a curb to trap dirt and grime, and they provide excellent water drainage when properly installed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include improved accessibility, reduced fall risk, a modern aesthetic, and easier cleaning. It can also increase home value.
